page.overview:
What is Fight for the Darksaber?

The fight for the Darksaber was a duel between Paz Vizsla and Din Djarin that took place on the Mandalorian covert on Glavis Ringworld, in 9 ABY. Vizsla, who was a member of House Vizsla, challenged Djarin for a duel so he could regain the Darksaber, a weapon whose wielder could lead the Mandalorians, back to his Clan. Eventually the Armorer stopped the duel when Djarin held a knife near Vizsla's throat, and asked them if they removed their helmets. When Djarin admitted that he had, the Armorer replied that he was no longer a Mandalorian, and Vizsla told him to leave. Djarin left the covert with the Darksaber.
